inputs.name: hand over from CI/CD Pipeline to Containerization

output.level_0: The pipeline crashes before packaging, leaving no container artifacts for the deployment team to use.
output.level_1: No handoff exists, so developers build images locally without any connection to the CI/CD pipeline.
output.level_2: Developers manually trigger container builds after pipeline success, often forgetting to update version tags.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically triggers container builds and pushes images to the registry upon success.
output.level_4: Container handoffs are governed by policy, ensuring only signed images from approved pipelines are accepted.
